{{Top|leg}}
The '''Master Designers Council''' was an organization of high importance for the [[unidentified Iokath species]]. Its purpose was to construct and maintain [[Project Iokath]] which transformed an entire [[Iokath system/Legends|star system]] into a new artificial habitat for the species, which was called [[Iokath]]. The Master Designers Council issued a decree commencing the start of an effort to develop a expandable and adaptable home for its people.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|History of Iokath: Entry 4}}</ref>
